analyst_view.overall: Leaders Almería (1st, 35 points, 29 scored and 13 conceded) host Nicolás Larcamón's Sporting Gijón (10th, 23 points) on Sunday night, with Almería clear favourites. Almería have won three in a row in the league, the latest 3-2 at Ceuta, though lately they have taken fewer shots and corners than usual and let opponents shoot more, which the numbers count. EFE confirms bans for Almería midfielder Stefan Dzodic and Sporting right-back Guille Rosas (one of Sporting's joint top scorers with 3); the numbers count Rosas but no longer list Dzodic, while Melamed (Almería) and Sporting's Sarco and Manu Rodríguez are counted as injured. Sporting have one league win in five and lost 0-2 at home to Las Palmas last time. No referee is named and fresh team news was thin.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals, 2.0 for Almería, already allowing for Rosas' absence at both ends and Sarco's and Melamed's injuries. Dzodic's ban, confirmed by EFE, is not on the numbers' list; as a midfielder who rarely scores, his absence could open the game a touch for Sporting but hardly changes Almería's attack, so I stay at about 2.9.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, already cut for Almería's low recent corner count (14 in six) and raised for Sporting, as Almería have conceded 44 in six. Almería still score from set pieces, as at Ceuta, but nothing new points to a different count, so I stay at 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.9 cards, 3.6 for Sporting, already raised 12% for their recent bookings (five yellows against Las Palmas, Rosas' fifth among them) and a little for past meetings. Sporting chasing the leaders could foul more, but that is how the numbers already see it, and no referee is named, so I stay at 5.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.6 shots, already lowered for Almería's quieter recent shooting (58 in six) and lifted 19% for Sporting's, as Almería have let opponents shoot 111 times in six. Sporting's attacking injuries have lasted weeks and are in those figures, so I stay at 27.6.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target, 5.8 for Almería, whose recent accuracy dipped a little while Sporting's rose. Almería's top scorer De la Fuente (9 goals) and Arribas (5) are available as far as reported, which the numbers expect, so I stay at about 10.
